summary: Health insurance claim denial due to alleged nondisclosure of pre-existing rheumatic heart disease; ovarian cancer treatment reimbursement; post-policy expiry renewals under interim orders; concealment irrelevant to unrelated critical illness; fraud/misrepresentation permitting non-renewal per IRDAI guidelines; renewal orders set aside post-final judgment; pre-6.7.2009 claims upheld; post-6.7.2009 claims rejected; reliance on Sulbha Prakash Motegaonkar distinguished; Satwant Kaur Sandhu precedent applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Reliance Life Insurance Co. v Rekhaben Nareshbhai Rathod
Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. v Mahendra Construction
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed: pre-6.7.2009 reimbursement upheld; post-6.7.2009 renewals set aside; National Commission order affirmed for later period; costs awarded.
